cloudflare.account_error: The last sync of {account} failed. It is tried again by itself.
cloudflare.admin_host: This instance is reached on this host: a list item there could answer before it. Choose another host.
cloudflare.busy: Another host is being set up. Wait for it to end, then try again.
cloudflare.confirm_live: This host already has a record that points somewhere. Read the plan, tick its confirmation, then confirm again.
cloudflare.conflict: A record at this name is not proxied by Cloudflare. Change or remove it in Cloudflare, or choose another name.
cloudflare.domains_intro: Each host is one name in a Cloudflare zone, proxied by Cloudflare, whose account holds the moonie_redirect list and its rule. A link takes a host as its address in its own form.
cloudflare.error_admin_host: This host is now the address of this instance: no item is sent for it, so nothing in the Cloudflare list answers before this instance. Move its links to another address.
cloudflare.error_foreign_item: An item this app did not make holds this address in the Cloudflare list. Remove it there or choose another path, then sync again.
cloudflare.error_internal: Something went wrong in this app while syncing. Its log says more.
cloudflare.error_list_full: The redirect list is full: this item waits for a free place.
cloudflare.error_list_missing: The moonie_redirect list is gone from this account: nothing is sent. Set a host up again to create it.
cloudflare.error_operation_expired: Cloudflare did not finish a change to the redirect list within 15 minutes.
cloudflare.error_operation_failed: Cloudflare could not apply the change to the redirect list.
cloudflare.error_origin_live: This host's record now points at a real origin: this item is not sent.
cloudflare.error_page_loop: The page for unknown paths of this host leads back to a host set up here: this item is not sent.
cloudflare.error_permission: The API token lacks a permission for the redirect list. Add it to the token in Cloudflare.
cloudflare.error_rate_limited: Cloudflare asked to slow down. The change is sent again once it allows.
cloudflare.error_token_invalid: Cloudflare does not accept the API token. Replace it in Settings, under Cloudflare.
cloudflare.error_unknown: An error this page does not know. Reload the page.
cloudflare.f_label_help: One name, before the zone: go gives go.example.com.
cloudflare.fallback_address_label: Address of the page for the unknown paths of {host}
cloudflare.fallback_address_new: Address of the page for unknown paths
cloudflare.fallback_blocked_full: The list is full: this page waits for a free place.
cloudflare.fallback_blocked_held: Another item holds this host's root: this page is not in use.
cloudflare.fallback_blocked_live: This host's record now points at a real origin, so no item is sent, as it would send its paths away. An item already there stays until you choose None.
cloudflare.fallback_blocked_loops: This page leads back to a host set up here, so a path with no link would go round in a loop: it is not sent. Choose another page.
cloudflare.fallback_blocked_refused: Cloudflare refused this page, so unknown paths do not reach it. Try again with Sync now, or give another page.
cloudflare.fallback_invalid: Give an address, or choose None.
cloudflare.fallback_label: Page for the unknown paths of {host}
cloudflare.fallback_loop: This address is on a host set up here, so a path with no link could go round in a loop. Give an address on another site.
cloudflare.fallback_none: None: this host was already there when it was set up here, and may serve a site.
cloudflare.hosts_live_text: {hosts}: the record now points at a real origin, so the sync sends no page for unknown paths. Choose None, or point the record back.
cloudflare.hosts_none: No host yet. Add one, then give it to links as their address.
cloudflare.internal: Cloudflare's answer could not be read. Try again later.
cloudflare.intro: Links, NanoURLs and QR codes that Cloudflare also serves on hosts of your own zones, with no request reaching this instance.
cloudflare.label_invalid: Enter one name of 1 to 63 letters, digits or dashes, with no dot and no dash at either end.
cloudflare.lists_full: The account already holds the most lists its plan allows. Delete a list in Cloudflare, then try again.
cloudflare.needs_admin: Only the admin, logged in, can do this.
cloudflare.new_host_text: Choose a zone and a name. Nothing changes in Cloudflare until you confirm the plan shown below.
cloudflare.no_answer: The instance did not answer as expected. Reload the page, then try again.
cloudflare.notice_fallback: The unknown paths of {host} will go to {choice} after the next sync.
cloudflare.notice_fallback_full: {choice} is saved for {host}, but the list is full: unknown paths will go there once a place is free.
cloudflare.notice_fallback_held: {choice} is saved for {host}, but another item holds its root: unknown paths will not go there until that item is gone.
cloudflare.notice_fallback_live: {choice} is saved for {host}, but its record now points at a real origin: no item is sent.
cloudflare.notice_fallback_none: {host} has no page for unknown paths any more: its item goes with the next sync.
cloudflare.notice_host: {host} is set up. Links can take it as their address now.
cloudflare.notice_sync: Sync started. Links in error are tried again.
cloudflare.off_desc: Set a Cloudflare API token above. Links keep working on this instance meanwhile.
cloudflare.page_points_here: Another host here has its page for unknown paths on this name, so a path with no link could go round in a loop. Choose another page for that host first, or choose another name.
cloudflare.permission: The API token lacks a permission for this. Add it to the token in Cloudflare, then try again.
cloudflare.plan_live: {host} already has a proxied record that points somewhere, so it probably serves visitors today. List items answer before its origin: a link given this host would take that path over. Its paths with no link keep reaching the origin.
cloudflare.plan_live_confirm: I understand that a link given this host takes over what that path serves today.
cloudflare.plan_stale: Cloudflare changed since this plan was shown. Review the new plan, then confirm again.
cloudflare.quota_full_text: {account} uses all {limit} of its list items: no link can get a host of this account. Move links back to the LAN, or raise the limit if your plan allows more.
cloudflare.quota_near_text: {account} uses {used} of its {limit} list items. Move links you no longer need back to the LAN before the list is full.
cloudflare.rate_limited: Cloudflare asks to slow down. Wait a minute, then try again.
cloudflare.refused: Cloudflare refused the request. The app's log says more.
cloudflare.remote_changed: Cloudflare changed since the comparison. Compare again, then confirm.
cloudflare.remove_text: The {count} ticked list item(s) will be deleted in Cloudflare, those not made by this app included, and their addresses stop redirecting. This cannot be undone.
cloudflare.resync_clean: Cloudflare holds exactly what this instance holds.
cloudflare.resync_done: {pushed} sent again, {removed} removal(s) on their way.
cloudflare.resync_text: Ticked links are sent to Cloudflare again. A list item is removed only if you tick it, and confirm once more.
cloudflare.rules_full: The account's redirect rules are full. Remove a Bulk Redirects rule in Cloudflare, then try again.
cloudflare.step_add_fallback: Add the list item {source}, which sends every path with no link to {target}. The table of hosts can change that page.
cloudflare.step_add_rule: Add one rule for the list beside the account's own rules, which stay as they are.
cloudflare.step_create_entrypoint: Create the account's Bulk Redirects ruleset, which it does not have yet.
cloudflare.step_create_list: Create the redirect list {name} in the account.
cloudflare.step_keep_ours: Keep {name} as a host created here: that record is the placeholder an earlier setup made, so it serves no site and the host may have a page for unknown paths.
cloudflare.step_no_fallback: Add no page for unknown paths: {name} was not created here, so its paths with no link keep reaching what they reach today.
cloudflare.step_root_full: Leave {source} out for now: the list is full, so the host's unknown paths will go to a chosen page once a place is free.
cloudflare.step_root_held: Leave the list item {source} as it is: something else holds this root, so the host's unknown paths will not go to a chosen page while it is there.
cloudflare.step_unknown: A step this page does not know. Reload the page.
cloudflare.step_use_record: Use the proxied record {type} {name} → {content} already there, unchanged.
cloudflare.token_invalid: Cloudflare does not accept the API token. Replace it in Settings, under Cloudflare.
cloudflare.token_missing_text: The API token lacks {permissions}. Add them to the token in Cloudflare, then reload this page.
cloudflare.token_refused_text: Cloudflare does not accept the API token, so nothing is synced. Replace the token.
cloudflare.token_unchecked_text: Cloudflare could not be reached to check the token. The page shows what this instance holds; try again later.
cloudflare.token_unverified_text: These permissions could not be checked, since the token sees no zone or account to try them on: {permissions}.
cloudflare.unreachable: Cloudflare could not be reached. Check the instance's network, then try again.
cloudflare.zones_none: The token sees no zone. Give it Zone Read on the zones to use.
errors.csrf: The request came from another origin and was refused. Use the instance’s own address and try again.
errors.not_found: Nothing was found at this address. Check it and try again.
errors.scope_denied: This API key does not hold the scope for this. Use a key that does, or log in.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 1 s.
errors.unauthorized: Log in or send a valid API key.
instance.end_sessions_text: Everyone signed in is signed out at once, you included. You will need the password to come back.
instance.fact_brake: A wrong password holds the next attempt for {seconds} s
instance.password_done: Password changed. Every other session has ended.
instance.password_file: Read from MOONIE_REDIRECT_PASSWORD_FILE. A password changed here is kept by the instance and wins over the file.
instance.password_text: Every other session ends. This one stays open.
instance.signin_desc: Applies to the administrator account. API keys stay valid: revoke them under Webhook & API.
keys.desc: Each key allows only the actions in its scopes. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
keys.empty_desc: Keys are for automated calls, such as scripts and automation tools. This session already has every action.
keys.field_name_help: Identifies the key in this list.
keys.field_password_help: A key outlives this session, so it asks for the password again.
keys.field_scopes_help: Separate them with spaces or commas. * allows everything, redirect:* or cloudflare:* one side.
keys.file_note: The token file allows everything (*). To revoke it, remove the file and restart the app.
keys.revoke_text: Calls that send this key are refused at once. This cannot be undone.
keys.secret_text: It will not be shown again. Only its prefix stays visible.
keys.title: API keys
notfound.desc: This address does not match any page of this app.
notfound.title: Page not found
redirect.address_admin_host: This instance is reached on this host: a link there could answer before it. Choose another address.
redirect.address_host_help: Also answers at {url}, served by Cloudflare. The address on this instance keeps working.
redirect.address_invalid: Choose the LAN or a host set up here.
redirect.address_taken: This host already answers this path for another link. Choose another slug or address.
redirect.address_unknown: This host is not set up here, or no longer is. Choose another address.
redirect.address_well_known: Paths under .well-known are reserved on a Cloudflare host: certificates and security contacts are read there.
redirect.break_text: {url} stops working once Cloudflare has removed it, on every printed code and shared link that holds it. The address on this instance keeps working.
redirect.cloudflare_off: Cloudflare is off on this instance: choose the LAN.
redirect.confirm_break: This change stops a Cloudflare address. Confirm it, then save again.
redirect.delete_text: {url} will stop working for everyone who has it.
redirect.desc: Fixed links whose target can change: links and QR codes already shared keep working. Most recently modified first.
redirect.design_contrast: The colors are too close to the background: scanners may not be able to read the QR code.
redirect.design_logo: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
redirect.design_logo_size: The logo must be 256 KB or smaller.
redirect.design_unreadable: The saved design of this QR code is not valid. Save a new design.
redirect.discard_text: Your changes in this form are not saved and will be lost.
redirect.expires_on_invalid: Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD, or leave it empty.
redirect.f_help: Leave the expiry empty for a link that never expires.
redirect.name: Redirect
redirect.name_invalid: The name cannot contain control or invisible characters.
redirect.name_taken: This name is already used on this page.
redirect.name_too_long: The name must be at most 100 characters.
redirect.name_unusable: This name cannot make a slug: a slug needs at least one Latin letter or digit, and at most 255 characters.
redirect.nano_desc: A name and a target make a short link. You can change the target without breaking the link. Most recently modified first.
redirect.nano_name_help: The slug comes from the name: NanoURL/<name>, keeping only Latin letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
redirect.nano_none_yet: No NanoURLs yet. Enter a name and a target in the form, and the application makes the short link.
redirect.nano_path_warning: Renaming changes the path: {path} stops working, and another NanoURL may take it later. The short link stays the same.
redirect.none_yet: No links yet. Fill in the form to create the first one: its target can change at any time without breaking it for the people who use it.
redirect.qr_desc: Each QR code holds a short link: change its target at any time and printed copies keep working. Most recently modified first.
redirect.qr_logo_help: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 256 KB. With a logo, the QR code uses the strongest error correction.
redirect.qr_name_help: The slug comes from the name: QRcodes/<name>, keeping only Latin letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
redirect.qr_none_match: No QR codes match this search.
redirect.qr_none_yet: No QR codes yet. Enter a name and a target in the form, choose a design, then download the SVG.
redirect.qr_notice_gone: This QR code no longer exists.
redirect.quota_full: The Cloudflare list of this host's account is full. Move other links back to the LAN, or choose the LAN.
redirect.slug_dot_segment: A slug segment cannot be . or ..
redirect.slug_empty_segment: The slug cannot start or end with /, or contain //.
redirect.slug_invalid: Use only letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, with / between segments.
redirect.slug_reserved: Slugs starting with Api, QRcodes or NanoURL are reserved by this application.
redirect.slug_taken: This slug is already used by another link.
redirect.slug_too_long: The slug must be at most 255 characters.
redirect.slug_warning: Changing the slug breaks any link you have already shared: the old one will answer “not found”.
redirect.status_kept: This link answers {code}, a permanent redirect. Saving here keeps it; only the API changes it.
redirect.target_invalid: Enter a full URL that starts with http:// or https://.
redirect.target_too_long: The target URL must be at most 2048 characters.
settings.cf_clear_text: Links on Cloudflare hosts stop syncing until a token is back. If a token file is set, it is used again.
settings.cf_limit_help: How many redirects your Cloudflare plan allows across the account’s lists. Leave empty for the default: 10,000 on the free plan.
settings.cf_limit_invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave the field empty.
settings.cf_perm_dns_why: creates the placeholder record of a new host
settings.cf_perm_lists_why: creates the moonie_redirect list and writes its items
settings.cf_perm_rulesets_why: adds the rule that redirects from that list
settings.cf_perm_zone_why: lists the zones the token can see
settings.cf_token_help: Create it in Cloudflare, under My Profile or Manage Account, with one account policy and one zone policy on every account and zone to use. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.cf_token_invalid: This is not a Cloudflare API token. Paste the token’s value as Cloudflare shows it.
settings.cf_token_refused: Cloudflare does not accept this token. Nothing was stored.
settings.cf_token_unreadable: The store key changed since this token was set, so it cannot be read. Enter it again, or clear it to use the token file.
settings.password_length: The password must be 12 to 1024 characters long.
state.error_desc: The request to the instance failed. Retry, or open another page.
state.error_title: This page could not be loaded
state.form_no_response: The instance did not respond. Try again.
webhook.clear_desc: The URL, the secret, the events and the deliveries waiting are deleted.
webhook.desc: Each ticked event is sent as a signed POST to this URL, for the receiver to act on.
webhook.disabled_desc: The receiver responded 410 Gone, so no events are sent for now. Events already waiting stay in the queue, and Save turns the webhook back on.
webhook.empty_desc: Enter the URL of a webhook receiver to send it the changes to this instance’s links.
webhook.events_desc: A link, NanoURL or QR code created, changed or deleted, from this page or with an API key.
webhook.field_secret: The secret must be 16 to 256 characters long.
webhook.field_secret_required: Enter a signing secret: this webhook has none yet.
webhook.field_url: Enter an http or https URL, with no username or password.
webhook.field_url_closed: This address is closed: loopback, link-local, metadata, multicast and reserved addresses are refused.
webhook.reply_help: The receiver has this long to respond to each delivery. A 2xx response counts as delivered; no response, 408, 429 or 5xx is tried again, up to 5 attempts.
webhook.secret_help: Write-only: stored in the instance and never shown again. Signs every event in X-Moonie-Signature (HMAC SHA-256), so that the receiver can check it.
webhook.secret_kept: Leave empty to keep the current secret
webhook.secret_unreadable: The store key changed since this secret was set, so nothing is sent. Enter a new secret.
webhook.test_busy: A test is already running. Try again in a moment.
webhook.test_not_configured: Save the webhook before testing it.
webhook.test_reply_other: The receiver responded, but not with JSON.
webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.url_cleartext: Plain http: events travel unencrypted. Use https beyond the local network.
